events.text: Good day! I've loaded incident IC-2005 for Condominio Torre Horizonte. Tell me calmly what happened, with times and everything, and I'll log each thing as you say it.
Hello?
I'm done with the building pump job.
I'm in the van now, all quiet over here.
Log the incident report for me.
